claim: The demo opens a sample and never reads or writes real slips.
where: First-screen action, demo banner, Privacy, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; save a real slip, enter /demo in one click, reset, leave, verify real data, then enter ?demo=1

claim: CSV keeps each cost row's supplier bill reference, category, amount, currency, and billable or overhead choice.
sandbox: fresh /demo; download CSV and parse every seeded row

claim: Stores image and PDF attachments up to 10 MB in this browser.
sandbox: fresh real workspace; attach a PDF before any fields, verify its draft record and reload; then use /demo to reload image and 10,000,000-byte PDF attachments and reject 10,000,001 bytes

claim: The demo sends no requests to other websites.
sandbox: fresh /demo; use recorded extraction, attach, save, export, copy, print, backup, import, reset, and leave while recording requests

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh /demo; wait for the service worker, go offline, and reload
fresh /demo; save, reload, export CSV, and copy client line list without a license or paywall

claim: Client line lists and printed client line lists include billable rows only.
sandbox: fresh /demo; copy and print the sample, then inspect both outputs

claim: JSON backups export saved slip details without attachment files.
sandbox: fresh /demo; attach a file, export JSON, and inspect saved details and omitted attachment bytes

claim: Saved slips and attachments stay in this browser.
sandbox: fresh /demo; save an edited sample with an attachment and reload

claim: Shows exact cent totals with balanced, under, and over states.
sandbox: fresh /demo; assert the seeded balance, then make it under and over by exact cents

claim: Split Cost Slip can be installed as an app in supported Chromium browsers.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; inspect installability errors, manifest, icons, start URL, display mode, and service worker

claim: Manual bill entry, storage, and exports stay in this browser; Split Cost Slip does not receive or sync that data.
sandbox: fresh real workspace; attach, enter, save, export, reload, and assert no request leaves the product origin

claim: Deleting a slip removes its saved details and attachment.
sandbox: fresh real workspace; attach a PDF before any fields, reload, confirm deletion, inspect both IndexedDB stores, and reload again

claim: Optional extraction sends the named attachment only after the user starts it, keeps the key locally, returns editable facts, and leaves treatment to the user.
sandbox: fresh real workspace; intercept model and streaming response fixtures, inspect the request, edit and classify suggestions, apply, undo, and remove the key
